note: Brad ruled (2026-10-31, filed 2026-11-01): the trial reuses his existing F:\RetroArch install (ppsspp, swanstation, mednafen_psx_hw, pcsx_rearmed, pcsx2) instead of shipping portable PPSSPP/DuckStation - so no Dokan driver was needed and F:\RetroArch stays read-only. Found while auditing it: system\psx has a full BIOS set, system\psp has no flash0 firmware, and pause_on_window_lost_focus is default-on (an unfocused RetroArch window renders black).

Method rule from the trial: probe a desktop app's config UI with UI Automation first; when every rect comes back (,,0x0) the UI is unreachable, so write config offline into the app's own store while it is stopped (backed up in F:\Lab\trials\plbak\) and let the app's own scan prove the edit. SimpleLauncher's UI is UIA-visible, so it was configured by clicking - the offline route is the fallback, not the default.

Brad ruled: a trial app's runtime is satisfied portably inside F:\Lab\trials\, never system-wide. SimpleLauncher 5.8.4 needs .NET 10, so F:\Lab\trials\dotnet10 (10.0.2) runs it via DOTNET_ROOT and deleting trials\ removes the dependency with no uninstall step.

Brad ruled the live launch scope: one PSP ISO per frontend (Grand Theft Auto - Chinatown Wars), and the multi-disc PSX live launch is explicitly skipped - multi-disc behaviour is judged from scan output plus the frontend's own source, not from a playthrough.

card-018 trial results recorded against Brad's real library (E:\Sony\PSP = 33 ISOs; E:\Sony\PSX = 52 CHDs, 23 discs in 9 multi-disc sets; zero .m3u anywhere). Playnite: scan 71 new / 76 total - 33 PSP + 38 PSX with all 9 sets collapsed into single entries holding multi-entry Roms, IGDB artwork auto-filled, Playtime/PlayCount written, live PSP ISO launch passed (playnite.log shows retroarch.exe -L ppsspp_libretro.dll + the ISO, two focused frames hashed differently, Playtime 848 / PlayCount 1). SimpleLauncher: PSP 33 tiles, PSX 52 tiles with every disc its own tile - no collapse, no disc chaining, no generated .m3u - no artwork for non-Steam systems, live PSP launch passed with the same command line and PlayHistory 1 / TotalPlayTime 287. Per-tile menu has no disc or emulator picker. Verdict on Brad's discriminator: Playnite passes, SimpleLauncher does not. Both apps and every trial window closed; F:\RetroArch untouched; restore points kept.
